name: run-apparel-viewer-monorepo
description: RUN APPAREL — QR-deep-linkable 3D apparel product viewer (viewer + Payload CMS + asset pipeline)

scripts.seed:assets: pnpm --filter @run-apparel/asset-pipeline start placeholders --out output/placeholders && pnpm --filter @run-apparel/asset-pipeline start merge --out output/n001.glb output/placeholders/n001-navy.glb=N001-NAVY output/placeholders/n001-black.glb=N001-BLACK output/placeholders/n001-crimson.glb=N001-CRIMSON && pnpm --filter @run-apparel/asset-pipeline start validate output/n001.glb --expect N001-NAVY,N001-BLACK,N001-CRIMSON
